name: voice-input
title: Voice Input
description: Record and play a voice note
useCases: In a discussion, a user records a voice comment and stops recording. The app attaches the resulting audio file to the message.
In a notes form, an author dictates an idea. The app sends the Blob from onRecord to its transcription service.
task: Record and play a voice note
behavior: Recording requests microphone access. On stop, onRecord receives a Blob with the actual recording MIME type for storage or upload.
